**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Standard Windows 11 chrome (Title bar + Taskbar).
*   **Sidebar (Left):** Fixed width ~280px. Contains navigation groups.
    *   **Data Recovery Group:** [0, 140] to [280, 205].
    *   **Advanced Features Group:** [0, 360] to [280, 510].
    *   **File Backup Group:** [0, 555] to [280, 645].
*   **Main Content Area (Right):** Flexible width. Padding ~40px.
    *   **Header:** "Select a location..." [310, 110].
    *   **Internal Drives Section:** Header [310, 195]. Grid of cards (2 columns visible).
    *   **Specify Location Section:** Header [310, 405]. Grid of location cards (2 columns).
    *   **Footer Bar:** Sticky bottom [290, 840] to [1024, 930]. Left: Help text. Right: Primary CTA.
*   **AI Assistant Overlay (Floating):** Top-Right quadrant. [645, 65] to [895, 390]. Drop shadow elevation.
*   **Taskbar (Bottom):** Standard Windows 11 centered icons.

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar - Headers:** `Data Recovery`, `Advanced Features`, `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar - Items:** `Hardware Disk`, `SD Card`, `More Recovery Tools`, `File Repair`, `Lost Partition Rescue`, `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Header:** `Select a location to search for lost data`
*   **Section Header 1:** `Internal drives (2)`
*   **Card 1 (Selected):** `Windows(C:)`, `30.96 GB/149.45 GB`
*   **Section Header 2:** `Specify a location`
*   **Location Item 1:** `Recycle Bin`
*   **Location Item 2:** `Desktop`
*   **Location Item 3:** `Select Folder`
*   **Footer Left:** `Unable to find your hard drive?` (with info icon)
*   **Footer CTA:** `Search for Lost Data`
*   **AI Panel Header:** `Hi Guess you need:`
*   **AI List Item 1:** `Unable to find your hard drive?`
*   **AI List Item 2:** `Try Advanced File Repair`
*   **AI List Item 3:** `Quick start guide`
*   **AI List Item 4:** `Chat with us`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   App Background: `#F5F8FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Sidebar Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Card Background (Selected): `#FFFFFF` with `#2D8CF0` Border
    *   Card Background (Normal): Transparent or very subtle white
    *   AI Panel BG: `#FFFFFF`
    *   AI Panel Header BG: `#F0F4FF` (Very light blue tint)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headers/Names): `#333333` / `#1F1F1F`
    *   Secondary Text (Sizes/Captions): `#666666` / `#888888`
    *   Selected Text: `#000000`
    *   Link/Accent Text: `#2D8CF0` (Blue)
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Selection Border: `#2D8CF0` (Bright Blue)
    *   Progress Bar Fill: `#2D8CF0`
    *   Progress Bar Track: `#E6E6E6`
    *   CTA Button BG: `#1677FF` (System Blue) or `#2D8CF0`
    *   CTA Text: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Sidebar Selection Highlight: `#E6F0FF` (Light blue strip/bg)

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Heading ("Select a location..."):** Segoe UI / System, ~24px, Semi-bold (600).
*   **Section Headers ("Internal drives...", "Specify..."):** Segoe UI, ~14px, Regular (400), Dark Grey.
*   **Card Titles ("Windows(C:)", "Recycle Bin"):** Segoe UI, ~15px, Medium (500).
*   **Card Meta ("30.96 GB..."):** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular, Muted Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Regular.
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Medium.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~260-280px.
*   **Card Dimensions:** Approx 340px width x 110px height.
*   **Card Internal Padding:** ~16px.
*   **Card Icon Size:** 48x48px.
*   **Gutter (Grid Gap):** ~20px horizontal, ~24px vertical.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Cards: 8px.
    *   Buttons: 6px.
    *   AI Panel: 12px.
*   **Progress Bar Height:** ~6px.
*   **CTA Button Height:** ~44px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (Hardware Disk):**
    *   **State:** Selected / Active.
    *   **Indicators:** Light blue background strip on left edge, blue text, green checkmark badge on right.
*   **Device Tile (Windows C:):**
    *   **State:** Selected / Checked.
    *   **Indicators:** Blue border (2px), Blue checkmark icon in top-right corner.
    *   **Sub-control:** Progress bar showing capacity usage.
*   **Device Tile (Drive D: - Partially visible):**
    *   **State:** Normal / Unselected.
*   **Location Tiles (Recycle Bin, Desktop, Folder):**
    *   **State:** Normal / Unselected. Hover likely adds border/shadow.
*   **Primary Button ("Search for Lost Data"):**
    *   **Type:** Filled Button (Call to Action).
    *   **State:** Normal (Enabled). Bright blue background, white text.
*   **AI Assistant Panel:**
    *   **Type:** Popover / Tooltip.
    *   **State:** Open / Visible.
    *   **Controls:** List of clickable links/items.

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline & Filled mix, "Fluent" / Modern Windows style.
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Grid of 4 squares (Blue filled).
    *   SD Card: SD card shape (Grey outline).
    *   Tools: Wrench/Screwdriver (Grey outline).
    *   File Repair: Document with tool (Grey outline).
    *   Partition: Circle/Chart (Grey outline).
    *   Backup: Circular arrows (Grey outline).
*   **Main Area Icons:**
    *   Drive Icon: 3D Isometric style HDD/SSD graphic (Blue/Grey).
    *   Recycle Bin: 3D Isometric Bin (Grey).
    *   Desktop: 3D Isometric Monitor (Grey).
    *   Folder: 3D Isometric Folder (Grey).
*   **Status Icons:**
    *   Checkmark (Green circle): Sidebar selection.
    *   Checkmark (Blue circle): Tile selection.
    *   Info (i): Footer help text.
    *   Headset: AI panel "Chat with us".
    *   Sparkle/Magic: AI panel items (implied context).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Ready**. The user is at the first step of the wizard (Select Location). A default drive is pre-selected. No data is loading (no spinners), no errors blocking the view (though a "soft" error/help prompt exists in footer and AI).
*   **Motion Cues:**
    *   The **AI Assistant** appears to be an active overlay, possibly recently triggered or persistent. It has a slight drop shadow suggesting it floats above the main UI layer (`z-index` elevation).
    *   The **Selection** on the C: drive is static in this shot but implies interactivity.
